audit.summary: Date-related accuracy differences are supported descriptively, but the core inference identifying outdated representations and necessity of continuous pre-training is not established; released gold truncation, temporal summaries and chronology validation add material limitations.
limitations: Limitations: No author code, model/API, generation or training was executed. Independent checks are synthetic logic/arithmetic examples, not raw-data replication.
Limitations: Full QA/news datasets, response records, scoring/plotting code and historical prompts/configs unavailable within acquired source-only packet.
Limitations: Separate OpenReview attachments unavailable behind 403/challenge. Bibliography not independently audited.
Limitations: NASA current resource dates a path map to April 2023; exact historical 15-state count and original article first publication not independently recovered.
P1 — Counterevidence: High gold scores establish many answerable items; refusal-excluded declines persist; authors acknowledge generator/selection limits. None isolates mechanism.
